summary: Splendor is a light engine-building game where players collect gem tokens to buy development cards, which in turn provide permanent discounts that snowball toward richer purchases and noble visits. It plays in about half an hour and is often a gateway game for new players.
praised: extremely quick to teach and play
satisfying engine snowball as discounts compound
portable and reliably enjoyable as a filler
criticised: limited direct interaction beyond taking chips or sniping a card someone wants
can feel a bit solitaire once you're deep in your own plan
luck of the card flip affects available options

interaction.detail: Players draw from the same limited pool of gem tokens and the same face-up card row, so taking a token or buying a card someone else needed is the main way you affect opponents. Otherwise each player builds their own private engine of cards largely independent of others' boards.

win_criteria: Most points, one or two sources

scoring.why: Points come almost entirely from development card prestige values plus occasional noble visit bonuses.
scoring.how_you_win: You win by being first to reach 15 points, usually by building a gem-discount engine that lets you afford high-value cards faster than opponents.
